commit.message:
feat(replays): Implement recording consumer using arroyo primitives (#42186)

Should be safer and easier to maintain than the custom consumer we
currently have. Inspired by the recent change which added threading to
the single message type. This pull should prevent those errors in the
future by simplifying the interface.

- Flattens the consumer module and the companion test module.
- Remove custom strategy and uses arroyo primitives.
- Keeps consumer behavior in the consumer module and moves ingest
related behavior into the usecase.
- No behavioral changes.

closes: https://github.com/getsentry/replay-backend/issues/238

commit.message:
fix(replays): correctly process uncompressed replays (#41111)

- uncompressed replays get parsed in `messagepack.unpackb` as a string.
this caused us to raise an error as when we split, we expect it to be
bytes.
- fixes this by encoding as bytes if its a string.
- also fixes the tests to be more production-like in regards to the data
of the payloads

Fixes SENTRY-WDT

commit.message:
feat(replays): add replay_sent analytic event (#40417)

- adds a `first_replay_received` signal
- adds an analytics event `first_replay.sent`
- in our replay `_store` method, look for our flag we added in #40408,
and if it's not set, fire our signal which will set the flag and send an
analytics event.


closes https://github.com/getsentry/replay-backend/issues/169
